description: The Airflow DAGs that read a table, from DataHub downstream lineage (DataHub records downstream consumers as jobs, not tables).

cases.name: downstream_dags_fct_transaction_variations
cases.query: Which Airflow DAGs read core_data.fct_transaction_variations downstream? Reply with a single JSON object only. Do not wrap it in markdown fences and do not add any other text. Required shape: {"table": "<db.table>", "downstream_dags": ["<Airflow DAG id>", "..."]}
cases.notes: Gold verified against DataHub lineage on 2026-11-20 (GMS via kubectl port-forward). 56 downstream jobs; gold is the two DAGs with the most of them. Others are allowed.
